how_to_read: Capacity figures are management statements and differ in what they count (annual or monthly, installed or operational, one product or several). Output is each company's total dispatches or production from NSE filings, or Vahan registrations where noted. Utilisation = monthly output divided by one twelfth of the annual capacity in force that month, so a rising capacity makes earlier months look busier than they were. Where output runs above stated capacity, the stated figure is usually out of date.

Total installed capacity as of 30 July 2026

companies.name: Bajaj
companies.measure: Overall monthly capacity across the businesses (two-wheelers, three-wheelers)

history.note: 625,000 units a month, as stated in October 2026

companies.planned: 775,000 units a month over the next 6 to 9 months

EV capacity is about 60,000 a month but only 40,000 shipped in September after a supply-chain miss.

companies.name: TVS

history.note: About 6.8 million as stated in July 2026

companies.planned: 8.3 million; in November said it will cross 8 million and must plan more for next year

companies.name: Ather

history.note: 35,000 a month, as stated in May 2026
